resources.string: Mute revokes POST_NOTIFICATIONS and is read back from Permissions. Listener and Do Not Disturb access are read back from Android settings. Protected apps are refused.
Not applicable: this app does not request POST_NOTIFICATIONS.
Fixed by system or policy, so it cannot be changed here.
This app declares no notification listener service.
Listener access could not be read on this ROM. Changes are disabled.
Do Not Disturb access could not be read on this ROM.
%1$s will be able to read every notification on this phone, including messages and one-time codes. Only allow apps you trust.
%1$s will no longer be able to read notifications. Features that rely on it may stop working.
%1$s will be able to turn Do Not Disturb on and off and change its rules.
